subject.title: fix(ios): defer QR pairing after scanner dismissal

question: Should the route-scoped gateway credential, device-token, watch, and APNs ownership hardening stay bundled with this QR scanner crash fix after the current head is rebased and physically proven?
rationale: The scanner deferral is a narrow bug fix, but the branch also changes upgrade-sensitive auth reuse and approval delivery behavior that needs explicit compatibility intent beyond line-level code review.

options.title: Keep Bundled After Proof
options.body: Accept the broader ownership hardening in this PR, but require a clean merge base and redacted physical iPhone proof on the exact final head before merge.

options.title: Split Scanner Fix
options.body: Land a narrower scanner-dismissal fix first and move route-scoped auth/watch behavior to a separate compatibility-reviewed PR.

options.title: Hold For Migration Design
options.body: Pause the PR until legacy credential, token, watch, and APNs upgrade behavior is specified and validated as a standalone migration path.

recommendation.title: Keep Bundled After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the broader ownership hardening in this PR, but require a clean merge base and redacted physical iPhone proof on the exact final head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the branch commits that introduced the bundled ownership hardening.
